title: Coordinates beyond the range of the model
how: The model holds lengths strictly inside plus or minus 2^30 nm, a little over 1073 mm;
R1 is at x = 2000 mm, the wire ends at 99999999999999999999 mm and the via is at x = 1100 mm: three items left out,
each counted by name in one note (PHOENIX-EAGLE-022); R2 is read, with its 2 pads and the pad net of its contactref;
the 2 layers, the 1 package, the 1 signal remain.
